name: Contextual prayer experience
userOutcome: Open Anjali, receive or discover a fitting reviewed prayer, see its text and meaning, practice through self-led Chant or Silent, or Listen only when that exact prayer has approved human audio, then return to the day.
entryPoints: Find tab browser by Moment, Intention, or Deity
productionDataSource: Bundled Anjali/Anjali/Resources/prayers.json plus optional exact-ID, rights-cleared, named-human-approved recordings; current normal builds contain no audio and use no network or fallback fixture.
errorBehavior: Malformed content is skipped, a missing library shows an explicit empty/error state, Listen is omitted when no exact approved human recording exists, a selected recording that fails to load or play leaves the session unstarted and offers Chant or Silent without running a pretend timer or recording completion, and a failed completion save is disclosed without pretending history was updated.
accessibilityRequirements: VoiceOver names and hints for primary actions
meaning is not conveyed by color alone
prohibitedBehavior: Do not surface prayers marked unreviewed or needsReview.
Do not fabricate cultural sign-off or Sanskrit provenance.
Do not offer Listen when the exact prayer recording is absent from the current bundle.

Do not include synthetic or provisional audio in normal public Debug, device, Release, or App Store builds; the bounded TestFlight pilot exception requires visible experimental-audio disclosure and exact-ID assets.
Do not play a sibling, same-deity, same-theme, or fuzzy-name audio asset for the displayed prayer.
Do not present estimated lyric timing as synchronized with a recording.
Do not describe Chant as recorded playback; it is self-led aloud.
Do not describe Silent as audio; it is inward reading or repetition.
Do not auto-complete Chant or Silent from elapsed time; require the explicit Complete action.
Do not record a Listen completion unless playback actually started and completed.
Do not report a completion as persisted when SwiftData save failed.
Do not use network or sample prayer fallbacks in production.
